target: Create the docs/03-reference/orchestrator-integration/ skeletons referenced in TP-DMX-ORCH-002..017 allowlists
invariants: Docs only — no runtime, no test changes
Every skeleton page links to its corresponding Task Packet and proof bundle
Skeletons describe OBSERVED behavior only; speculative content must be labelled UNKNOWN or PROPOSED
All pages pass repo markdownlint and the YAML-frontmatter validator
No bridge surface is described as an authority

pr.title: docs(orchestrator): seed orchestrator-integration reference skeletons
pr.body: Adds the docs/03-reference/orchestrator-integration/** reference skeletons that the TP-DMX-ORCH-002..017 allowlists name but do not yet populate. Each skeleton links to its Task Packet + proof bundle and labels its content OBSERVED / UNKNOWN / PROPOSED per the governance doctrine.

steps.task: Inventory every docs/03-reference/orchestrator-integration/** path referenced by the TP-DMX-ORCH-{002..017} commit.allowlist arrays and the operator-integration-authority.md cross-references.
validation: Inventory enumerates each path with its referencing packet IDs.
Any path referenced by an allowlist but absent from the repo is flagged for skeleton creation.

steps.task: Define a single skeleton template (Diataxis: reference) with YAML frontmatter (id, title, type, owner, date, related_packets, related_proof_bundles).
validation: Template renders cleanly through the repo YAML-frontmatter validator.

steps.task: Write the 17 listed _index.md and topic pages, each populated from the template with content scoped to OBSERVED facts from this repo plus links to the relevant packets and proof bundles.
validation: Every page has frontmatter, owner, date.
Every page links to at least one packet and one proof bundle.
No page describes dopecon-bridge or dope-context as a canonical writer.

steps.task: Audit cross-links: each packet/proof bundle listed in a page's frontmatter must actually exist in the repo.
validation: rg-based audit shows zero broken refs.
Each new page is reachable from docs/03-reference/orchestrator-integration/_index.md.

steps.task: Emit proof bundle at proof/dmx-orch-integration/TP-DMX-ORCH-DOCS-001/PROOF.json with the full validations array, repo_identity_check, codereview/precommit status, not_run, residual_risks, and rollback_plan.
validation: Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only after every page passes lint and link audit.
